import json,time,signal
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from scripts import diag_p106b_native595_public as d
def alarm(signum,frame): raise TimeoutError("independent CPU audit 600-second cap")
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,alarm); signal.alarm(600)
began=datetime.now(timezone.utc); tick=time.perf_counter()
print("[INDEPENDENT_CPU_START] "+began.isoformat(),flush=True)
assert began.isoformat()<"2026-10-21T07:50:00+00:00"
p=d.build_runtime(); info0=p.info(); spent0=p.spent_seconds()
reference,rows,tok,cached=p.prepared()
lookup={r["id"]:r for r in cached}; summaries={}; comparisons={}; pins={}; samples={}; total=scored=0
for model_id in p.MODELS:
    report,events=p.read_model(model_id,reference,rows,tok)
    assert p.sha(report["summary"])==p.sha(p.recount(events,p.cohort(rows,model_id)))
    summaries[model_id]=report["summary"]; total+=report["requested"]; scored+=report["scored"]
    cells={}
    for task in p.ENGLISH:
        actual=[e for e in events if e["task"]==task and not e["skipped"]]
        assert len(actual)==256 and {e["scores"]["id"] for e in actual}=={r["id"] for r in cached if r["task"]==task}
        assert all(lookup[e["scores"]["id"]]["gold"]==e["scores"]["gold"] for e in actual)
        right=sum(e["scores"]["pred_harness"]==e["scores"]["gold"] for e in actual)
        left=sum(lookup[e["scores"]["id"]]["correct"] for e in actual)
        cells[task]=dict(n_common=256,common_ids_sha256=p.sha(sorted(e["scores"]["id"] for e in actual)),cached_falcon_correct=left,current_model_correct=right,model_minus_cached_falcon=(right-left)/256)
    comparisons[model_id]=cells
    key=p.phase_key("evaluate",model_id); rp=p.result_path(key); ap=p.EVIDENCE/("activity_"+key+".json")
    pins[model_id]=dict(report=dict(path=str(rp.relative_to(p.ROOT)),bytes=rp.stat().st_size,sha256=p.digest(rp)),activity=dict(path=str(ap.relative_to(p.ROOT)),bytes=ap.stat().st_size,sha256=p.digest(ap)),checkpoint_sha256=report["checkpoint_sha256"],core_sha256=report["core_after"])
    case_lookup={p.row_id(r):r for r in p.cohort(rows,model_id)}
    samples[model_id]=[]
    for task in ("korquad_free","gsm8k_free"):
        selected=[e for e in events if e["task"]==task and not e["skipped"]][:2]
        for e in selected:
            r=case_lookup[e["id"]]
            samples[model_id].append(dict(id=e["id"],task=task,question=r.get("question"),item=r.get("item"),golds=r.get("golds"),answer=e["answer"],finish_reason=e["generation"]["finish_reason"],scores=e["scores"]))
    print("[INDEPENDENT_CPU_PROGRESS] "+json.dumps(dict(model=model_id,requested=report["requested"],scored=report["scored"])),flush=True)
assert (total,scored)==(9216,9212)
assert p.info()==info0 and p.spent_seconds()==spent0
p._public_assert_unchanged(); ended=datetime.now(timezone.utc); elapsed=time.perf_counter()-tick
assert ended.isoformat()<"2026-10-21T08:00:00+00:00" and elapsed<=600
signal.alarm(0)
result=dict(schema="P106B_NATIVE595_PUBLIC_INDEPENDENT_CPU_AUDIT_V2",status="SIX_CLOSED_MODELS_RAW_RECOUNTED_ORIGINAL_FAMILY_READBACK_HOLD",audit_namespace="p106b_native595_public_independent_audit_v2_s1337",original_tag=d.TAG,started_at=began.isoformat(),ended_at=ended.isoformat(),seconds=elapsed,utc_seconds=(ended-began).total_seconds(),own_cap_seconds=600,own_user_authority_end_utc="2026-10-21T08:00:00+00:00",original_family_limit_seconds=3600,original_family_spent_before=spent0,original_family_spent_after=p.spent_seconds(),original_namespace_unchanged=True,original_worker_or_writer_or_readback_called=False,models_loaded=0,checkpoint_tensor_loads=0,new_falcon_calls=0,training_updates=0,checkpoint_writes=0,actual_requested_rows=total,actual_scored_rows=scored,actual_length_excluded=total-scored,info=info0,pins=pins,summaries=summaries,same_id_cached_falcon=comparisons,cached_falcon=reference["binding"]["cached_falcon"],fixed_first_two_eligible_free_samples=samples,gsm_actual_scope="64 questions in one format per student, not128 independent",limitation="Existing public convenience pack and single seed; contamination unaudited. SUM_NLL MC is not free QA/conversation nor Falcon equivalence. This separately budgeted read-only audit does not complete the original family readback or enlarge its3600 cap.")
print("[INDEPENDENT_CPU_FINAL] "+json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
